execution_scope.description: Required. Where this task may work. Two legal shapes: {"roots": [root_id, ...]} claims whole registered roots, and {"resources": [{kind:"path", root_id, segments, mode:"read"|"consistent_read"|"exclusive_write"} | {kind:"named", namespace, name}]} claims individual paths or names. The key must be present, and {} is allowed: {} means "no explicit restriction". A {} scope claims no path, so begin prepares no workspace and takes no reservation, and the task is reported as not needing a workspace; the workspace resolver's fallback would inherit every root already registered on this project, but no begin reaches that fallback without a path claim.
